evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: The aphorism frames rehearsal as the condition for genuinely possessing a capability — conservation (security of having the rollback) wedded to competence (mastery through rehearsal).
Cadence language appeals to stability and security through regular, recurring practice — conservation as the appealed-to good.
Naming an owner appeals to capability and accountability — competence as the value underlying the assignment.

mints.name: UnrehearsedCapabilityIsNotPossessed
mints.title: a capability we have not rehearsed is a capability we do not actually have
mints.frame: Is the value move here equating possession of a capability with having rehearsed it, so that unrehearsed equals unreal?
